svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Shaft: 25 mm bright bar, 1,120 mm long, ends chamfered.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rollers: 101.6 x 4 mm tube cut 100 mm long; two 10 mm discs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 93 mm across, bored 25 mm, welded into each end of the tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide two rollers on, centred 147 mm each side of the middle of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft (294 mm apart, under the drum's rolling hoops).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld each disc to the shaft all round; skim the roller faces true

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in a lathe if they run out more than 0.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the shaft runs in two UCP205 pillow blocks, 1,040 mm apart,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: grub screws tightened on the shaft. Shaft centres 380 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the shaft turns freely by hand in its blocks; the rollers
